name: What is the average cost to replace a bathroom countertop in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to replace a bathroom countertop in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace a bathroom countertop in the Bay Area varies significantly based on material, size, edge profile, and labor rates. For example, solid surface or laminate can range from $50-$100 per square foot installed, while natural stone like granite or marble, or engineered quartz, often costs $75-$200+ per square foot. These estimates typically include material, fabrication, and installation, but can exclude old countertop removal and plumbing modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom countertop replacement costs in the Bay Area typically range from $50 to $200+ per square foot, depending on material choice and complexity.
